title: Self-Guided Centipede Desert UTV Rental
includes: 3-hours total (up to 1 hour check-in, up to 2 hours training & riding)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be at least 18+ with a valid ID and credit or debit card to book
All minors must be accompanied by a parent
No skirts or dresses, no open toed shoes
Must be at least 4-years-old to ride as a passenger
All guests must speak and understand English
A signed waiver will be required in order to participate
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Want to navigate these rugged trails on your own? No problem! With our Self-Guided tour, you will have two hours of unguided fun with our top-of-the-line UTVs (seats up to 4.) To book single-passenger ATVs for this tour, search for our "Self-Guided Centipede Desert ATV Rental." Enjoy this mountainous landscape at your own pace.

We offer the only “Show up and Ride” in the Bradshaw Mountains where you can ride right from our property! We will provide safety gear, a paper map, and a safety operations briefing on your vehicle.
